newsitem.title: DUBAI: Gulf Air NYK flights to transit Geneva.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Air NYK flights to transit Geneva.

text.p: Gulf Air flights to New York from Abu Dhabi and Bahrain will transit Geneva from October 27, the Bahrain-based airline said on Thursday.

"The decision to re-schedule the New York route was made in an effort to streamline services and combine two destinations that are much in demand with passengers from the Gulf," a company press release said.
Gulf Air flights to New York previously stopped in Cyprus but this service will end October 25.
Two weekly Gulf Air flights leave Abu Dhabi and Bahrain on Tuesday and Thursday mornings for New York with an additional flight from Abu Dhabi on Sunday, the company said.

Gulf Air, owned by the governments of Bahrain, Qatar, Oman and the United Arab Emirates state of Abu Dhabi made a $159 million loss in 1995. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
